## ✅ Tasks ready — `specs/001-bookmark-manager/tasks.md`

**62 tasks** across 12 phases, organized by user story so each ships as an independent, testable increment.

### Structure

| Phase | Tasks | What |
|-------|-------|------|
| 1 — Setup | T001–T005 | Workspaces, deps (incl. Playwright **pinned 1.61.0**), lint, gitignore |
| 2 — Foundational *(blocks all stories)* | T006–T011 | SQLite connection, full schema (incl. `title_user_set`/`description_user_set`), URL normalization, shared **Tag model (one identity per name)**, Express bootstrap on `0.0.0.0:4000`, React shell + `data-harness-ready` |
| 3 — **US1 Save w/ auto-details** 🎯 MVP | T012–T020 | incl. the **safeguard unit test (T013)** + metadata conditional-write (T016) |
| 4 — US2 Browse & open | T021–T024 | |
| 5 — US3 Organize | T025–T030 | Markdown notes, tag suggest/click-filter, read/archive, permanent delete |
| 6 — US4 Search | T031–T037 | grammar tokenizer/parser/evaluator + unit tests |
| 7 — US5 Bulk | T038–T040 | |
| 8 — US6 Saved searches | T041–T044 | include/exclude tags |
| 9 — US7 Snapshots & Internet Archive | T045–T049 | self-contained HTML / PDF passthrough |
| 10 — US8 Import/export | T050–T054 | Netscape round-trip incl. tags + date added |
| 11 — US9 Preferences | T055–T057 | |
| 12 — Polish | T058–T062 | `app.json`, 500-item perf fixture, security, README, SC-001–010 verification |

### Tasks per story
US1: 9 · US2: 4 · US3: 6 · US4: 7 · US5: 3 · US6: 4 · US7: 5 · US8: 5 · US9: 3 (+11 foundational/setup, +5 polish).

### Tests included (as the plan required)
Unit: URL (T012), **delayed-metadata safeguard (T013)**, search grammar (T031), Netscape round-trip (T050). E2E: one Playwright journey per story (T014, T021, T025, T032, T038, T041, T045, T051, T055).

### Suggested MVP & parallelism
- **MVP = Setup + Foundational + US1** (T001–T020) → save with auto-metadata, editing, duplicate-opens-existing, and the safeguard. Adding **US2** completes the capture→browse loop.
- Key sequencing note: US4's search evaluator is reused by US5's "apply to all matching," so US4 precedes US5 if built sequentially; US3/US4/US5 share the bookmarks route/model so their route edits should be sequenced.

### 👉 At this gate

- **Approve** and I'll begin implementation with `speckit-implement`, working through the phases (MVP first).
- **Want changes** — reordering, scope of a phase, more/fewer tests? Tell me and I'll adjust.
